module: Node "AI Chase" (color ai, once_p_duration). Puts a vehicle in "chase" AI mode to pursue another vehicle, with intentional contact. Inputs: aiVehId (no value = player vehicle), targetId (defaults to the player vehicle).
notes: If aiVehId is not provided, the player vehicle is both the chaser and the target by default.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Sends ai.setMode("chase") then ai.setTargetObjectID(targetId) to the vehicle.
